signatures.description: Implement a consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes where rebalancing honors a bounded-migration budget: keys must never move more than K hops per node join, and a dual-write window must keep stale reads consistent while data drains. Include a deterministic tie-break for vnode ownership collisions and prove at-least-once delivery for in-flight writes during the window.
